text:
No skater in the league has added more wins with his goals than Cutter Gauthier. The Ducks winger has 21 goals in 22 games, 17 of them in his last ten, and 17 power-play points. He's playing 18:47 a night, on the ice for 88% of Anaheim's power-play chances, and his ice time has climbed nearly two minutes over the hot stretch.

The heater is partly earned. His own expected goals (the quality of his chances) are up to 1.62 per 60 from 1.36, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking put him in the 99th percentile of forwards for chances from in front of the net last season. But 21 goals on 11.2 expected, shooting 21%, is a finishing gap that rarely lasts. At five on five, the Ducks get only 44.9% of the expected goals with him on.

The old story followed him back into the news this week: Sportskeeda carried Flyers GM Daniel Briere firing back at Elliotte Friedman's report on the Gauthier trade, saying "Just trying to get some free clicks on it." The chances are his; watch how far the shooting percentage settles.
